{{Quote|Galactic Exploitation wants my family's share of the miners' cooperative?<br />That's right. You sign your share over to GET, then GET pays me, and your debt is settled. Simple.|Omad Kaeg and Scarn, on the Qreph brother's attempt to acquire Kaeg's share in the miners' support cooperative|<ref name="Crucible" />}}
A '''miners' support cooperative''' operated in the [[Chiloon Rift/Legends|Chiloon Rift]] [[Nebula/Legends|nebula]] during the era of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]]. In [[45 ABY]], the [[Columi/Legends|Columi]] businessmen [[Craitheus Qreph|Craitheus]] and [[Marvid Qreph]] unsuccessfully attempted to force the [[Asteroid tug|tug]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] [[Omad Kaeg]] to transfer over to them his founder's share in the cooperative.

==Description==
{{Quote|All I know is, the bosses want to join your little co-op. Maybe they're worried one of their yachts will need to be rescued or repaired or something.''"<br />"''Then they can pay for an associate membership. I'm not giving you a founder's share. I'd be run out the Rift.|Scarn and Omad Kaeg, on the Qreph brothers' desire to join the miners' cooperative|<ref name="Crucible" />}}
A miners' support cooperative operated in the [[Chiloon Rift/Legends|Chiloon Rift]], a resource-rich [[Nebula/Legends|nebula]]<ref name="Crucible" /> in [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]].<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> Individuals holding founder's shares in the cooperative held rights regarding the organization's operation and also could receive representation on the [[RiftMesh Committee]], the body that oversaw the nebula's [[RiftMesh]] communications network. Associate membership of the cooperative was also available for those lacking a founder's share.<ref name="Crucible" />

==History==
{{Quote|The support cooperative gave up trying to extend the RiftMesh into the Bubble more than a hundred years ago. The beacons kept drifting out of range of each other, no matter how many the repair crews placed.|Omad Kaeg, on the cooperative's failed attempt to extend the RiftMesh to the Bubble of the Lost|<ref name="Crucible" />}}
Sometime before [[55 BBY/Legends|55 BBY]],<ref name="Date">[[Crucible (novel)|''Crucible'']] states that the unsuccessful attempt to expand the [[RiftMesh]] to the [[Bubble of the Lost]] occurred over one hundred [[Standard year/Legends|years]] prior to the events of the novel. Since ''Crucible'' is set in [[45 ABY]], this places the failed RiftMesh expansion effort to before [[55 BBY/Legends|55 BBY]].</ref> the cooperative attempted to expand the RiftMesh into the [[Bubble of the Lost]], a region in the heart of the Chiloon Rift that surrounded a [[Unidentified monolith|monolith of unknown origin]]. However, the [[Space–time-warping gate|space-time-warping]] properties of the monolith prevented the RiftMesh from functioning in the region by causing the [[repeater beacon]]s that supported the network to drift out of position.<ref name="Crucible" />

[[File:JustLando-AlliesBackCover.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Lando Calrissian, the Sarnus Refinery owner who met Omar Kaeg via the miners' support cooperative]]
During the era of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]], the [[asteroid tug]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] [[Omad Kaeg]] controlled a family founder's share in the co-operative. Through his work with the cooperative, Kaeg became familiar with the operator of the Chiloon Rift's [[Sarnus Refinery]], [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]]. In [[45 ABY]], the Columi businessmen [[Craitheus Qreph|Craitheus]] and [[Marvid Qreph]], the leaders of the corporation [[Galactic Exploitation Technologies]], sent the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] [[Scarn]] to coerce Kaeg into transferring his share over to them to settle a [[Gambling/Legends|gambling]] debt. Kaeg resisted and he and Calrissian subsequently speculated that the Columi wanted to join the co-operative so as to influence the decisions of the RiftMesh committee and ensure their [[Base Prime|hidden operation]] in the Chiloon Rift remained concealed.<ref name="Crucible" />

Following the detainment by the [[new Jedi Order]] of [[Dena Yus]], an employee of Calrissian and [[Spy/Legends|spy]] for the Qrephs, the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] sought the miners' co-operative's consent to take Yus away to stand trial before the [[Jedi High Council (New Jedi Order)|Jedi Council]].<ref name="Crucible" />

==Behind the scenes==
The miners' support cooperative was mentioned in the [[2013]] [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] novel [[Crucible (novel)|''Crucible'']], written by [[Troy Denning]].<ref name="Crucible" />
